newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end mixed in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end mixed in thin trading.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed for the second consecutive session in a market that saw low levels of trade because of the Labor Day holiday in the United States.
Medellin's IBOMED general price index fell a razor-thin 0.07 percent to close at 13,190.60 on a much lower-than-average volume of 523 million pesos.
Bogota's IBB index closed up 0.70 percent, ending at 841.11 on a volume of 1.06 million pesos.
The day's winners in Bogota were led by heavily-traded Banco de Colombia, the country's second-largest bank in terms of assets.
In Medellin, brokers said the price index was depressed by a 1.40 percent drop in Banco Industrial Colombiano, which accounted for a fifth of total volume and closed at 3,500 pesos per share.
Ganadero and Banco de Colombia rose in Medellin but they failed to match their price hikes in Bogota.
Ganadero's ordinary shares closed up 0.38 percent at 263 pesos a share while Banco de Colombia ended up 1.63 percent at 434 pesos a share. -- Javier Mozzo, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944
